# =============================================================================
# Paperclip — Cloudflare Workers deployment configuration
#
# After running `wrangler deploy` for the first time, fill in the placeholder
# IDs that Cloudflare generates (search for "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY").
#
# Quick start:
#   1. wrangler deploy
#   2. wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
#      Then paste the returned ID into [hyperdrive] binding below.
#   3. Open https://<your-worker>.workers.dev/setup to complete first-run setup.
# =============================================================================

name = "paperclip-api"
compatibility_date = "2025-03-01"
compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]
main = "dist/worker.js"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Static assets — serves the React UI build from ui/dist alongside the Worker.
# not_found_handling = "single-page-application" makes CF serve index.html for
# any path that doesn't match a static file (needed for client-side routing).
# The Worker gets an ASSETS Fetcher binding to delegate non-API requests.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[assets]
directory = "../../ui/dist"
binding = "ASSETS"
not_found_handling = "single-page-application"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables (non-secret; override secrets via `wrangler secret put`)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[vars]
DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM = "cloudflare"
DEPLOYMENT_MODE = "authenticated"
DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE = "public"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# R2 object storage — artifacts, skill bundles, attachments, DB backups
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[r2_buckets]]
binding = "PAPERCLIP_STORAGE"
bucket_name = "paperclip-storage"
# preview_bucket_name = "paperclip-storage-preview"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# KV — sessions cache, hot config, first-run setup flag
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[kv_namespaces]]
binding = "PAPERCLIP_KV"
id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"
# preview_id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY_PREVIEW"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hyperdrive — Phase 1: wraps Neon/Postgres for low-latency DB access
# After deploying: wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[hyperdrive]]
binding = "HYPERDRIVE"
id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"
localConnectionString = "postgres://paperclip:paperclip@127.0.0.1:54329/paperclip"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Queues — background fanout (cost rollups, activity log flush, plugin jobs)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[queues.producers]]
binding = "PAPERCLIP_QUEUE"
queue = "paperclip-jobs"

[[queues.consumers]]
queue = "paperclip-jobs"
max_batch_size = 10
max_batch_timeout = 5
max_retries = 3
dead_letter_queue = "paperclip-jobs-dlq"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Durable Objects — per-task state, per-agent-run state, scheduler alarms
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[durable_objects.bindings]]
name = "TASK_DO"
class_name = "TaskDO"

[[durable_objects.bindings]]
name = "AGENT_RUN_DO"
class_name = "AgentRunDO"

[[durable_objects.bindings]]
name = "SCHEDULER_DO"
class_name = "SchedulerDO"

# DO migrations — bump new_classes when adding a new DO class
[[migrations]]
tag = "v1"
new_classes = ["TaskDO", "AgentRunDO", "SchedulerDO"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Workflows — checkpointed multi-step agent execution
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[[workflows]]
binding = "HEARTBEAT_WORKFLOW"
name = "heartbeat-workflow"
class_name = "HeartbeatWorkflow"
script_name = "paperclip-api"

[[workflows]]
binding = "PLUGIN_DISPATCH_WORKFLOW"
name = "plugin-dispatch-workflow"
class_name = "PluginDispatchWorkflow"
script_name = "paperclip-api"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cron triggers — fire heartbeat sweep, budget checks, DB backup
# Adjust intervals to taste; avoid high-frequency triggers (see CLOUDFLARE.md §10)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[triggers]
crons = [
  "*/5 * * * *",   # heartbeat sweep every 5 minutes
  "0 * * * *",     # budget threshold check every hour
  "0 3 * * *",     # DB backup daily at 03:00 UTC
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cloudflare Containers — run execution services natively on Cloudflare.
#
# CF Containers (beta) let Workers communicate with Docker containers via
# a Fetcher service binding. No external servers needed.
#
# Required secrets (set via `wrangler secret put`):
#   - none for containers (authentication is implicit via the binding)
#
# For external sidecar fallback (optional, for non-CF deployments):
#   wrangler secret put SIDECAR_URL
#   wrangler secret put SIDECAR_API_KEY
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Sidecar — companion Node.js server for agent heartbeat execution, plugin job
# lifecycle (claim/execute/complete), filesystem and git operations.
# Exposes POST /internal/heartbeat, POST /internal/plugin-jobs/:id/* endpoints.
[[containers]]
binding = "SIDECAR_SERVICE"
image = "ghcr.io/paperclipai/paperclip-sidecar:latest"

# Plugin sandbox — isolated command execution environment for adapter plugins.
# Exposes POST /execute and POST /cancel/:runId (same wire format as the
# sandbox bridge HTTP API so both executors are fully interchangeable).
[[containers]]
binding = "PLUGIN_CONTAINER"
image = "ghcr.io/paperclipai/plugin-sandbox:latest"
